title: LOCK & REMOTE CONTROL
summary: Inside the door (all models): the rods that connect the outside handle, the lock control and the inside remote control (the interior door release handle) to the door latch, plus the lock-access cover on the inner panel. The control and remote control are screwed to the door inner panel, the inside handle is screwed to the remote control, the knob is held on by a retainer through the trim, rods pass through grommets and snap to levers with clips, and the access cover is screwed on over a gasket.
